title: 88. Search a 2D Matrix

examples.explanation: Target 3 is present in the matrix.
Target 13 is not present in the matrix.
Target 1 is present in the matrix.

hints: The ordering is the same as if all rows were concatenated into one sorted array.
Binary-search a virtual one-dimensional index range from 0 to rows * columns - 1.
Map a virtual index i to matrix[i / columns][i % columns].
